episodes.synopsis: Two twin girls from the future of Tamagotchi Planet make their mark to follow their dreams to become great fashion designers.
episodes.title: Mystery. Miracle. Time Slip!?

episodes.synopsis: While Miraitchi and Clulutchi continue their quest to recover the Dreambakutchis, they encounter a shop that sounds suspicious to them.
episodes.title: Full of Mystery!? X Kamen vs Miracrise!

episodes.synopsis: Miraitchi and Clulutchi reveal to their new friends their secret of coming from the future.
episodes.title: Comrades to Believe in...Miracle Friends!

episodes.synopsis: The girls took an interest in Madamtchi's sewing machine, but it hasn't worked for a long time. While it is being checked, they heard that renowned craftsmen would be coming to town.
episodes.title: Restored! Madamtchi's Sewing Machine

episodes.synopsis: The Designing School will be hosting a Dream Festival made up of teams of two. But the twin girls soon find themselves in a situation where they were forced to pair up with someone else rather than each other.
episodes.title: Miracle Shock! Apart for the First Time...

episodes.synopsis: The gang help a self-depressed painter regain her self-esteem in art composition.
episodes.title: Worry? Cheery? Lucky Color of Dream

episodes.synopsis: Miraitchi and Clulutchi decide to hold a Tama Pet fashion service.
episodes.title: Tama Pet Fashion Baku~n ♥

episodes.synopsis: Mametchi and the others try to work out the truth behind X Kamen's identity.
episodes.title: Worrying!? X Kamen's Identity

episodes.synopsis: The students of Dream School work together to prepare for the Tamaween Event.
episodes.title: Doya! Tamaween Tumult

episodes.synopsis: Smartotchi makes a living on his first day of Music Class at Dream School.
episodes.title: Quickly Getting Closer! Tamatomo Smartotchi

episodes.synopsis: In the next upcoming dream festival, designing class will be put to the test once again to design the most fashionable outfit.
episodes.title: Rivals Today! Miracle Dorifes

episodes.synopsis: Two familiar friends returned to Dream Town for a homecoming. But after hearing their story, the gang decided to hold a small concert to jump start their lagging dreams.
episodes.title: Welcome Back Yume Kira! Revival ☆ Kira Kira Girls

episodes.synopsis: Watchlin accidentally lets one of the Dreambakutchis escape and she sets out to get it back herself before the others find out.
episodes.title: Dokidoki Bakubaku? Watchlin's Big Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: Miraitchi and Clulutchi enter a Tama Auction together where they are tasked to design an outfit.
episodes.title: How Many Stars? Tama Auction Meeting!!

episodes.synopsis: Miraitchi and Clulutchi try to find the perfect Christmas present for Madamtchi, with the help of their friends.
episodes.title: Gift ♪ Madamtchi's Present

episodes.synopsis: Santabluetchi seeks to give a present to his partner Bluenosetchi, but Santabluetchi does not know what Bluenosetchi wants.
episodes.title: Another Merry Christmas ☆

episodes.synopsis: Madamtchi's treats the gang to a tropical island vacation.
episodes.title: Tsu-kun? Ma-kun? Refresh on the South Island

episodes.synopsis: Everyone celebrates the Chinese New Year festival. But then another Dreambakutchi appears and the gang must capture it before X-Kamen does.
episodes.title: Too Amazing! Serious Mode of X-Kamen

episodes.synopsis: Mametchi invents a robot that can help Miraitchi and Clulutchi find Dreambakutchis.
episodes.title: New Invention! Dreambakutchi Discovery Robo

episodes.synopsis: The Tama-Friend of Miraitchi and Clulutchi, Candy Pakupaku, arrives from the future.
episodes.title: I Also Came! Candy Pakupaku

episodes.synopsis: Candy Pakupaku captures X. But during investigation of another Dreambakutchi, X-Kamen appears...
episodes.title: Sad Future...X-Kamen's True Identity

episodes.synopsis: Miraitchi and Clulutchi unite with Smartotchi now that they understand his circumstances, and the gang promise to help their new Tama-Friend fulfill his dreams. Meanwhile, Ameartotchi is expressing mysterious behavior at Dream School...
episodes.title: The Dream of a Tama-Friend is the Dream of Everyone

episodes.synopsis: While searching for the next Dreambakutchi with the entire gang, Pianitchi and Smartchi end up getting lost together.
episodes.title: Search! Jungle of Baku~!?

episodes.synopsis: With all the Dreambakutchis collected, time travel back to the future is finally possible. This would mark the end of Miraitchi and Clulutchi's travels and Mametchi felt that it's time for his two new friends to part ways.
episodes.title: Premonition of Farewell... Discovery! Greenbakutchi

episodes.synopsis: Smartchi learns the surprising effects of the Dreambakutchi and makes a decision.
episodes.title: Smartotchi's Decision

episodes.synopsis: A rare creature known as a Crescent Irukatchi arrives at the coast of Dream Town. But it appears to have a reason staying at the coast.
episodes.title: Why Dolphin? Tell Us Dolphintchi

episodes.synopsis: A connection is discovered between the dreams of Crescent Irukatchi and Smartotchi.
episodes.title: Where the Dream is Born

episodes.synopsis: Something is going wrong in the future and everyone suspects that it's going under drastic changes.
episodes.title: Miracle of Dreambakutchi

episodes.synopsis: Everyone is now returning to their future. But Miraitchi and Clulutchi are reluctant to say their goodbyes to their friends.
episodes.title: Everyone's Dream...to the Future
